gloss: to get mixed up; to be lost in; to be distracted

definitions.gloss: to get mixed up; to blend in; to disappear into
definitions.explanation: To become indistinguishable within a group or situation, often intentionally to hide.

definitions.gloss: to be distracted; to be diverted
definitions.explanation: For one's attention or feelings to be diverted by something else.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{人混|ひとご}みに{紛|まぎ}れて{逃|に}げた。
examples.english: The criminal escaped by blending into the crowd.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}に{紛|まぎ}れて{悲|かな}しみを{忘|わす}れようとした。
examples.english: I tried to forget my sadness by losing myself in work.

examples.japanese: {騒|さわ}ぎに{紛|まぎ}れて、{大事|だいじ}な{書類|しょるい}がなくなった。
examples.english: In all the commotion, important documents went missing.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive verb)

TRANSITIVE PAIR:
{紛|まぎ}らす/{紛|まぎ}らわす - to divert, to distract (transitive)

CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}/{下一段|しもいちだん})
・{紛|まぎ}れない (negative)
・{紛|まぎ}れて (te-form)
・{紛|まぎ}れた (past)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜に{紛|まぎ}れる - to blend into ~, to get lost in ~
・{紛|まぎ}れもない - unmistakable, certain (idiomatic)
・{紛|まぎ}れもなく - unmistakably, certainly

COLLOCATIONS:
・{人混|ひとご}みに{紛|まぎ}れる - to blend into a crowd
・{闇|やみ}に{紛|まぎ}れる - to disappear into darkness
・{仕事|しごと}に{紛|まぎ}れる - to be absorbed in work
・{騒|さわ}ぎに{紛|まぎ}れる - to get lost in the commotion

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{気|き}を{紛|まぎ}らす - to distract oneself
